basic_details.job_title: UCSL Trade Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 11 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Udupi Cochin Shipyard (UCSL) has officially announced the Trade Apprentice (ITI) Recruitment 2026 with 11 openings. The detailed notification was published through Advt. No. UCSL/HR/APP/VN-ReN-ITI/2026/90 on the official website. Candidates who meet the minimum age criteria of 18 years as on 13.08.2026 and hold a Pass in X standard along with ITI in the concerned trade (National Trade Certificate - NTC) can submit their online applications. The application process will remain open until 13 August 2026. Direct links to download the notification and apply online are shared below.

age_limit.details: Minimum Age: 18 years as on 13.08.2026. Age relaxation rules are not specified in the provided data.

qualification.details: Pass in X standard. Pass in ITI in the concerned trade (National Trade Certificate (NTC) in the designated trades).

selection_process: Short-listing based on percentage of marks obtained in prescribed qualification Verification of certificates Medical fitness
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for UCSL Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 13-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for UCSL Trade Apprentice (ITI) posts?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting applications for the UCSL Trade Apprentice (ITI) posts is 13 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated email address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for UCSL Trade Apprentice (ITI) recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed X standard and possess an ITI certificate in the concerned trade, holding a National Trade Certificate (NTC).

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to UCSL Trade Apprentice (ITI) posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 18 years as of 13 August 2026. Specific age relaxation details are not provided in the summary.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the UCSL Trade Apprentice (ITI) positions?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to fill out the application form, paste a photograph, and email the scanned copies of the signed form and supporting documents to [email protected].

faq.question: Q5. What is the stipend offered to selected candidates?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a stipend of ₹ 12,600 per month, along with meals allowance.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for Trade Apprentice (ITI) posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 11 vacancies for the Trade Apprentice (ITI) posts at Udupi Cochin Shipyard Limited.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for UCSL Trade Apprentice (ITI) recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves short-listing based on academic marks, followed by certificate verification and a medical fitness test.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for UCSL Trade Apprentice (ITI) recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category of candidates applying for these posts.

faq.question: Q9. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job is on a contract basis, offering apprenticeship training for one year.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the Udupi Cochin Shipyard Limited located?
faq.answer: Udupi Cochin Shipyard Limited is located in Malpe, Karnataka.
